title: 1.4.1 Use of Color Mini-assessment
description: Complete after the required lesson activity.

elements.name: q1
elements.title: A required field is identified only by a red label. What should be added?
elements.feedback: A visible non-color cue communicates the requirement.

elements.name: q2
elements.title: Does high contrast alone communicate what red means?
elements.feedback: Contrast and the use of color convey different things.

elements.name: q3
elements.title: What can distinguish chart lines?
elements.feedback: Labels or patterns convey the distinction without relying on color.
